name: SPACE
description: Public-domain NASA mission footage on a permanent loop — Apollo, Saturn V, and the last shuttle launch. Channel 1, always on, never edited.
rightsNote: Every item here is US-government work published by NASA, which is generally not subject to copyright in the United States. Three standing rules for this pack, per the channel-1 spec: (1) the NASA insignia (meatball), the NASA logotype (worm), and the NASA seal are EXCLUDED — they must never appear in the pack or in any dumbTV marketing, because NASA's own media guidelines treat them as protected identifiers rather than public-domain content; (2) nothing here may imply NASA endorsement of dumbTV — the channel is named SPACE, not NASA, and no NASA branding appears in the guide, the banner, or the store listing; (3) identifiable people appear in this footage, and while the footage itself is free of copyright, personality/publicity rights are separate — so this material is presented as historical record and is never used in advertising. Anything sourced from NASA TV that carries third-party music or contractor-owned footage is out of scope for this pack.
